lines.japanese: 傷だらけの体を引きずり、両手でフライヤーだらけの壁をつたいながら、ふたたびあのきつい階段を下っていった。
lines.english: Dragging my battered body, both hands braced against walls plastered in flyers, I descended that steep staircase once more.

lines.japanese: 出ていったときよりも、コインロッカーにぶら下がっている鍵の数がだいぶ減っていた。俺はその鍵や鍵穴の並んだ脇をすり抜けて、まばゆい闇（もしくは暗い輝き）を目指す。
lines.english: Far fewer keys hung from the coin lockers than when I had left. I slipped past their ranks of keys and keyholes, making for the dazzling darkness—or the dark radiance.

lines.japanese: 午前２時を過ぎたダンスフロアは、飲み会を締めたあんちゃんやお水なお勤めを終えたねえさんをたらふく呑みこんで、さらに密度と室温を上げていた。
lines.english: Past two in the morning, the dance floor had swallowed its fill of guys whose drinking parties had wound down and women coming off shifts in the nightlife trade. The room grew tighter and hotter still.

lines.japanese: すでに腕を広げることもできないほど混みあった店内で、クラウドは互いに肩をぶつけながら体を揺らしている。俺はふと思う。鳴はぼけっとして足でも踏まれてないだろうか。
lines.english: The place was already too crowded to spread your arms. Bodies swayed shoulder to shoulder. A thought came to me: Naru was such a space case, had somebody stepped on her feet?

lines.japanese: 侘しげなシンセサイザーの音色が、吹きぬける風のような疾走感あふれるメロディを奏でている。
lines.english: A forlorn synthesizer carried a melody with all the headlong rush of wind.

lines.japanese: 闇の中に細かな緑の線が幾筋も走り、向かいのスクリーンでは液体金属みたいな幾何学模様が不規則に分裂や収縮を繰りかえしている。
lines.english: Fine green lines raced through the dark. Across the room, liquid-metal geometries split and contracted at random over the screen.

lines.japanese: 俺はスクリーンを横目にフロアを突っ切った。ノースリーブで踊る季節感のない女たちの群れに、手刀を刺しいれて道を空けさせる。
lines.english: I cut across the floor with one eye on the screen, parting a group of women in season-defying sleeveless tops with the edge of my hand.

lines.japanese: 分厚いガラスに隔てられた王の間。まるで眼を開けたまま眠っているように、やつはまだ同じテーブルに貼りついていた。
lines.english: Beyond the thick glass lay the king's chamber. As if asleep with his eyes open, he still clung to the same table.

lines.japanese: 俺はＶＩＰルームへ上がり、森里和馬の正面へ周りこんだ。俺の姿が視野に入ると、やつの虚ろな眼に色が点いた。薄く開いた唇がわずかに吊りあがり、眼窩の下で頬が隆起した。
lines.english: I climbed into the VIP room and came around to face Kazuma Morisato. The moment I entered his field of vision, color returned to his vacant eyes. His parted lips lifted faintly, and his cheeks rose beneath his eyes.

lines.japanese: 暗がりのせいか、はじめ俺にはそれが自虐的な嘲笑に見えた。しかしでたらめに照射されるピンスポットが触れたとき、それはもっとべつの表情だと気が付いた。
lines.english: At first, in the gloom, I took it for a self-mocking sneer. Then one of the wandering spotlights found him, and I realized it was something else.

lines.japanese: 困惑、あるいは怯え、いや──
lines.english: Confusion, or fear—no.

lines.japanese: ──安堵、か？
lines.english: —relief?

lines.japanese: 「ただいま」
lines.english: “I'm back.”

lines.japanese: 俺は低く短い一声に皮肉を込めて言いおとし、森里の座っている９０度横に立った。
lines.english: I dropped the short, low greeting with a barb buried in it and stopped at a right angle to Morisato's chair.

lines.japanese: やつは背を丸めて頬杖をついた姿勢から俺を見上げ、溜息をこぼすようにゆっくりまばたきした。
lines.english: He looked up at me from his hunched pose, cheek propped on one hand, and blinked slowly as though releasing a sigh.

lines.japanese: 「成田か……よく帰ってこられたな」
lines.english: “Narita... You actually made it back.”

lines.japanese: 「ヨユー」
lines.english: “Easy.”

lines.japanese: 俺は左手で右の上腕を叩き、肘から下を勢いよく突きあげてみせた。
lines.english: I slapped my right upper arm with my left hand and thrust my forearm up.

lines.japanese: 「はは、さすがだねェ」
lines.english: “Ha. Knew you could do it.”

lines.japanese: 「へえ、もっと残念そうな顔するかと思ってたけど」
lines.english: “Huh. I expected you to look more disappointed.”

lines.japanese: 「だよな。なんで俺、ほっとしてんのかね」
lines.english: “Yeah. Wonder why I'm so relieved.”

lines.japanese: 森里はそう言って、テーブルの上に広げた十本の指を見下ろした。
lines.english: Morisato looked down at the ten fingers spread across the table.

lines.japanese: 「ハッ、手の震え止まってるし」
lines.english: “Hah. My hands even stopped shaking.”

lines.japanese: 俺と目を合わせるのを避けるみたいに、じっと両手を見つめている。俺もその手を見下ろしながら言った。
lines.english: He stared at them as though avoiding my eyes. Looking down at the same hands, I spoke.

lines.japanese: 「なに。おまえ、自分で仕組んだくせして、いざとなったら俺の心配してたの」
lines.english: “What? You set the whole thing up yourself, but when the moment came, you were worried about me?”

lines.japanese: 「そりゃそうだ。きのう言ったろ」
lines.english: “Of course. I told you yesterday.”

lines.japanese: 森里は目を上げないまま、居直るように肩を揺らした。
lines.english: Without raising his eyes, Morisato gave a defiant little shrug.

lines.japanese: 「俺は半端モンなんだよ。罪の意識なくひとを裏切るとか、そんなん出来るほど大それた悪党じゃねえの」
lines.english: “I’m a half-assed bastard. I’m not enough of a villain to betray somebody without feeling guilty about it.”

lines.japanese: この期に及んで、俺は認めてほしくなかったのかもしれない。しかし、やつは罪を認めてしまった。あのしばしば見せる、いじけた強がりで自分を貶めるときの表情。
lines.english: Even now, perhaps I had wanted him to deny it. But he admitted it. There was that familiar face of his: sulky bravado turned inward, cutting himself down before anyone else could.

lines.japanese: 俺はわけもなく親指と人差し指で下唇を摘み、引っぱりながら、首を曲げてガラスの外の狂乱を眺めた。
lines.english: For no reason, I pinched my lower lip between thumb and forefinger and stretched it, bending my neck to watch the frenzy beyond the glass.

lines.japanese: ＤＪブースの中では、ベテランＡＶ男優みたいに不自然な若作りをしたおっさんが、悦に浸りながらターンテーブルを回していた。
lines.english: In the DJ booth, a middle-aged man with the forced youthfulness of a veteran porn actor spun records, plainly delighted with himself.

lines.japanese: 俺は後ろ頭を掻きながら向きなおり、空いてる席に腰を下ろした。
lines.english: Scratching the back of my head, I turned around and took an empty seat.

lines.japanese: 「さて、真犯人を確保したわけですが──」
lines.english: “Well. We've apprehended the real culprit—”

lines.japanese: 肘掛けに腕を預け、鷹揚に足を組む。
lines.english: I rested my arm on the armrest and crossed my legs with lordly ease.

lines.japanese: 「──どうしたもんですかね、このクソガキゃあ」
lines.english: “—so what do we do with the little shit?”

lines.japanese: 「好きにしろよ」
lines.english: “Whatever you want.”

lines.japanese: 森里は広げた指を組みあわせたりして弄びながら言った。
lines.english: Morisato spoke while toying with his splayed fingers, lacing and unlacing them.

lines.japanese: 「いずれにしたって、最後グダグダんなることぐれー分かってたし。いちおう覚悟なら出来てるよ。死ぬほど殴られたって文句は言わねえ」
lines.english: “I knew it was all going to fall apart at the end anyway. I've more or less made my peace with it. Beat me half to death if you want. I won't complain.”

lines.japanese: 「おー、そら面白そうだけどな。んなことしたら今度は俺がババ引くじゃねーか。障害致死とか殺人未遂とかで」
lines.english: “Sure, sounds fun. But then I’d be the one left holding the bag. Assault resulting in death, attempted murder—something like that.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ翔さんに渡してくれてもいいし、大司教んとこ突きだしたっていいし、警察行けってんなら行ってくるし。もう俺どのみち帰る場所ねえんだもん。おまえの言う通りにするよ、どこ行きゃいい？」
lines.english: “Then hand me over to Kakeru. Turn me in to the Archbishop. Tell me to go to the police and I’ll go. I’ve got nowhere to go back to anyway. I’ll do what you say. So where do I go?”

lines.japanese: 顔は両手に落としたまま、森里が上目遣いに俺をうかがった。うざい長髪が表情の半分を隠している。俺は脚をテーブルの外へ出して組みなおし、また首をフロアの方へ巡らせた。
lines.english: Morisato kept his head lowered over his hands and peered up at me through the long, irritating hair that hid half his face. I shifted my crossed legs out from under the table and looked toward the floor again.

lines.japanese: 「あんさ。そんなんより、先に聞きたいことあんだけど」
lines.english: “Look. Before any of that, there's something I want to ask.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、鳴さんならちゃんと帰したよ」
lines.english: “If you're asking about Naru, we made sure she got home.”

lines.japanese: 向きなおる。森里が髪に指を通して後ろへ梳いていた。
lines.english: I turned back. Morisato was combing his hair away from his face with his fingers.

lines.japanese: 「今日はもう翔さん来ねーだろってんで、さっきＬＲさんたちがタクシー呼んで乗せてた」
lines.english: “We figured Kakeru wasn't coming anymore tonight, so LR and the others called her a cab and saw her into it a little while ago.”

lines.japanese: 「ああそう」
lines.english: “Oh. Good.”

lines.japanese: 視線を一巡させた。隙間もないほど混みあってる群衆の中ほどに、背の高い肌色の頭がひとつ突きでて灯台の明かりみたいにゆらゆら揺れていた。実に見つけやすいハゲだ。
lines.english: I swept my gaze around the room. From the solid crush of bodies, one tall, flesh-colored head protruded and rocked like a lighthouse beacon. A remarkably easy bald man to spot.

lines.japanese: 「あと、亜衣もそれに同乗して帰ったから」
lines.english: “Ai rode home in the same cab.”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 俺は顔をしかめた。
lines.english: I frowned.

lines.japanese: 「……なに、亜衣ってここにいたの」
lines.english: “...What, Ai was here?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ。おまえが出てったあと、入れ替わりで遊びに来てさ。もうちょっとタイミングずれてたら鉢合わせだったな。ツイてるんだか、ツイてないんだか」
lines.english: “Yeah. She came by right after you left. A little shift in timing and you two would've run straight into each other. Hard to say whether that's lucky or unlucky.”

lines.japanese: 俺は舌の先で頬を突きながら、フライトジャケットのポケットに手を入れた。
lines.english: Prodding my cheek from within with my tongue, I reached into the pocket of my flight jacket.

lines.japanese: 「そだ、これ返すわ」
lines.english: “Oh, right. Here. Take this back.”

lines.japanese: 皺だらけの紙と封筒をテーブルの上に放る。森里は無言だったが、虫歯の痛みが再発したみたいな苦い顔をした。
lines.english: I tossed the crumpled paper and envelope onto the table. Morisato said nothing, but his face went bitter, as if an old toothache had flared again.

lines.japanese: 「念のため聞くけど、これって合成？」
lines.english: “Just to be sure, is this doctored?”

lines.japanese: 「俺、アイコラ職人かよ。んなテク持ってねえよ」
lines.english: “What am I, some Photoshop wizard? I don't have skills like that.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ合意？」
lines.english: “Then was it consensual?”

lines.japanese: 「いい加減、分かってるくせに聞くなよ。そういう仲じゃねえって、俺ら」
lines.english: “Come on. You already know, so quit asking. We aren't like that.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ、どうやって撮ったの」
lines.english: “Then how did you take it?”

lines.japanese: 「まあ、なんつーか、カラオケ屋で隙見てミン剤入れて」
lines.english: “Well… At the karaoke place, I waited for an opening and slipped her some sleeping pills.”
“Sleeping pills...”

lines.japanese: 俺は巨大な溜息を吐いて頭を落とした。すぐに同じような音が聞こえた。やつも同じことをしたみたいだった。
lines.english: I let out an enormous sigh and dropped my head. A moment later, I heard the same sound. Apparently he'd done the same.

lines.japanese: 俺はテーブルの上でこぶしとてのひらを打ちあわせた。その上に額を載せる。頭が重かった。
lines.english: I struck my fist into my palm on the table and rested my forehead upon them. My head felt heavy.

lines.japanese: 「……なんでおまえ、そんなん持ってんの」
lines.english: “…Why did you even have those?”

lines.japanese: 「なんでって、そんなん、病院で処方されてっからに決まってんじゃん。いま悩める若人って多いぜえ、うちの学校でもクラスに一人ぐらいは心療内科行ってんじゃねーかなあ」
lines.english: “Why? Because the hospital prescribed them. Plenty of young people have problems these days. I bet there's one person going to a mental-health clinic in every class at our school.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃなかったら、いまあの辺、ロッカーの辺りとか不自然にうろついてる外人に声かけてみ。落とし用に眠れる薬欲しいんですけどーとか言って。俺は買ったことねーけど、銀ハルでシート２、３千円らしいよ」
lines.english: “Otherwise, try talking to one of those foreigners hanging around the lockers looking out of place. Tell them you want something to knock somebody out. Never bought it myself, but I hear a blister pack of silver Halcion runs two or three thousand yen.”

lines.japanese: 「へえ」
lines.english: “Huh.”

lines.japanese: 重い頭をむりやり持ちあげて、いまだ俯いていた長髪のつむじを温度の上がらない目で見下した。
lines.english: I forced my heavy head upright and looked coldly down at the crown of the long-haired head still bowed before me.

lines.japanese: 「惚れた女にそんなん入れるなんて、おまえ、なかなか最低だな」
lines.english: “Drugging a girl you love... That’s seriously low.”

lines.japanese: 「同感だよ。魔が差したじゃ済まねえもんな。めたくそ自己嫌悪。だからマジ死にてえんだって、もう」
lines.english: “Agreed. ‘A moment of madness’ doesn't cover it. I hate myself so goddamn much. That's why I really do want to die.”

lines.japanese: やつは誰かが置きわすれていった、テーブルの上のごついオイルライターを拾った。
lines.english: He picked up a bulky oil lighter someone had left on the table.

lines.japanese: 「けっきょくビビり入ってやってねーんだけど、そーゆー問題じゃねえしな」
lines.english: “I chickened out and didn't go through with it, but that isn't the point.”

lines.japanese: 細くねじった後悔の端を、幅の広い炎が下から舐める。焦げくさい臭いが鼻をついた。
lines.english: A broad flame licked the bottom edge of a tightly twisted regret. The stench of scorching paper caught in my nose.

lines.japanese: 立ちのぼる白い煙を避けて、森里が頭を上げた。飛び出し事故みたいに視線がぶつかった。俺の硬い表情を、やつは疑惑の眼差しと取ったのか、勝手に言葉を続けた。
lines.english: Avoiding the rising white smoke, Morisato lifted his head. Our eyes collided like a pedestrian stepping into traffic. Perhaps he mistook my hard expression for disbelief, because he continued without prompting.

lines.japanese: 「いや、マジでやってねえよ。ぶっちゃけ俺チェリーだから、いざってなったら、えれーパニクっちゃって」
lines.english: “No, I mean it. I didn't do anything. Honestly, I'm a virgin. When the moment came, I panicked like hell.”

lines.japanese: 「写真撮ってケータイの画面に映ってる絵ヅラ見たら、なんだよコレただの犯罪じゃんつって、急に恐ええっつーか、あいつ可哀想んなっちゃって」
lines.english: “I took the picture, looked at it on my phone, and suddenly thought, what the hell, this is just a crime. It scared me—or rather, I started feeling sorry for her.”

lines.japanese: 「聞いてねえよ」
lines.english: “I didn’t ask.”

lines.japanese: 「どこまでやったとか関係ねーだろ。そんなん、立たなかったてめえの棒っきれの都合じゃねえか。あいつにくだらねえもん盛った時点で、おまえ終わってんだよ」
lines.english: “How far you went doesn't matter. That's just because your pathetic dick wouldn't get hard. The moment you slipped that shit into her drink, you were already done.”

lines.japanese: 「……だよな」
lines.english: “...Yeah.”

lines.japanese: 炎が大半を覆うと、やつは燃えあがるそれをアルミの灰皿へ落とした。
lines.english: When flame covered most of it, he dropped the burning thing into the aluminum ashtray.

lines.japanese: 「はあーあ。こうさあ、こんな風にメラメラっと、なんもかんも全部なかったことには出来ねえもんかねえ」
lines.english: “Haaah. Wouldn't it be nice if everything could just blaze up like this and never have happened at all?”

lines.japanese: 「出来るかよ！」
lines.english: “Like hell it can!”

lines.japanese: 森里はおどけて一人ツッコミを入れた。オレンジ色の炎が、泣きだしそうな情けない顔を照らしていた。やかましいぐらいに溜息の連呼。
lines.english: Morisato supplied his own mocking comeback. Orange flame illuminated his pathetic face, ready to cry, as he heaved one noisy sigh after another.

lines.japanese: もうもうと立ちのぼる白い煙から離れずに、やつは目ぇ痛てえとぼやきながら目蓋をこすっている。甘えんな。俺は灰皿をテーブルの端まで押しだした。おまえに泣く権利なんかねえよ。
lines.english: He stayed close to the billowing white smoke, grumbling that his eyes hurt as he rubbed his lids. Don't indulge yourself. I pushed the ashtray to the far edge of the table. You had no right to cry.

lines.japanese: やつはのっそり動いて隣りのテーブルへライターを返しに行ったが、そのまま逃げたりはせずすぐに戻ってきた。
lines.english: He lumbered to the next table to return the lighter, but didn't use the chance to flee. He came straight back.

lines.japanese: 「おう、さっき亜衣がここ来たって。あいつ、何しに来たの」
lines.english: “Hey. You said Ai came here earlier. What did she want?”

lines.japanese: 「何ってべつに、フツーに遊び来ただけだろ」
lines.english: “Nothing. She probably just came to hang out like normal.”

lines.japanese: やつは湿った睫毛を伏せて力なく言った。
lines.english: He lowered his damp lashes and answered weakly.

lines.japanese: 「酒と青玉のカクテルってマジ効くんだな。ぐっすりブッ飛んじゃって、あいつ何も知らねーんだ。まあ、カラオケ屋で仮眠取ってオールとか、それ自体は俺らの仲間うちじゃ特別珍しいことでもねーし」
lines.english: “Alcohol and a blue pill really work. She was completely out and doesn't know a thing. Sleeping at karaoke and staying out all night isn't exactly unusual in our group anyway.”

lines.japanese: 「つか、クスリ盛られたとか知ってたら、こんな犯罪者の生活範囲には一生近付かねーよな。どう考えても」
lines.english: “I mean, if she knew she’d been drugged, she’d never come anywhere near a criminal like me again. Obviously.”

lines.japanese: やつは肩を揺らしてそのまま落とした。俺はもはや何度目か分からない溜息をこぼした。
lines.english: His shoulders rose, then dropped. I let out a sigh I had long since lost count of.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあアレか。おまえ、もし俺にこんなん見せなかったら──」
lines.english: “So if you'd never shown me this—”

lines.japanese: 灰皿の中の炎を一瞥する。
lines.english: I glanced at the flame in the ashtray.

lines.japanese: 「──そのまま一生、誰にも知られねえで済んだわけだ」
lines.english: “—you could've lived out your whole life without anybody knowing.”

lines.japanese: 「かもねえ」
lines.english: “Maybe.”

lines.japanese: 森里はトランプ遊びの捨て札を悔やむような、その程度の味気ない嘆息を漏らした。俺は一度目を閉じて、また開けた。
lines.english: Morisato sighed with no more feeling than a cardplayer regretting a discard. I closed my eyes once, then opened them again.

lines.japanese: 「なに。そんなまでして、俺をムカつかせたかったの」
lines.english: “What. You went that far just because you wanted to piss me off?”

lines.japanese: 「まあな」
lines.english: “Pretty much.”

lines.japanese: 「へえ。おまえ、そんなに俺が嫌いなんだ」
lines.english: “Huh. You hate me that much?”

lines.japanese: 「あー、どうだろうな。成田おもしれーしな、言うほど嫌いじゃなかったかも」
lines.english: “Ah, who knows. You're entertaining, Narita. Maybe I didn't hate you as much as I made out.”

lines.japanese: 「ただ、まあ、おまえが消えてくれればって思うことは何度もあったよ。たとえばきのう、亜衣が泣いてんのに俺じゃ何もしてやれなかったときとかな」
lines.english: “Still, there were plenty of times I wished you'd disappear. Like yesterday, when Ai was crying and I couldn't do a damn thing for her.”

lines.japanese: やつはまた俺から目を逸らすために、灰皿を引きよせて燃えつきた黒い塊を爪の先で崩しはじめた。
lines.english: He drew the ashtray close, avoiding my eyes again, and began breaking apart the charred black lump with the tip of one nail.

lines.japanese: 「きのうさあ、俺ここ迎えにきて、亜衣んこと送ってったじゃん？　あんときあいつ落ちこんでたじゃん？」
lines.english: “Yesterday, right? I came here to pick Ai up and took her home. She was down in the dumps then, remember?”

lines.japanese: 尋ねられても俺はすぐに答えられなかった。俺は亜衣のことを可愛いガキだと思っているが、こいつのように何年も熱心に見詰めつづけてきたわけじゃない。
lines.english: Even asked outright, I had no immediate answer. I thought Ai was a cute kid, but I hadn't spent years watching her as closely as he had.

lines.japanese: 前日の記憶をじっくりと辿って、たしかに笑顔の合間合間に見えた亜衣の神妙な表情を思いだした。
lines.english: I slowly retraced the day before and remembered the grave little looks that had surfaced in the gaps between her smiles.

lines.japanese: 「見た目笑ってたけどさ、したって俺ら、めっちゃガキん頃からの付きあいだもん。んーなさ、分かんだよそんな、ウソかホントかぐれーはさ」
lines.english: “She looked like she was smiling, sure, but we've known each other since we were tiny. I can tell. I can tell when it's real and when she's faking.”

lines.japanese: 「……だろうな」
lines.english: “...Of course.”

lines.japanese: そう、こいつは誰よりも優しい目でずっと亜衣を見守ってきた。そう思ったからこそ、ゆうべの俺はこの男に託したんだ。
lines.english: Yes. He had watched over Ai all these years with kinder eyes than anyone. That was precisely why I had entrusted her to him last night.

lines.japanese: 「だからさ、なんとかこうアゲてやろうとか思ってぇ。そしたら丁度、呼び込みのあんちゃんが声かけてきてぇ。じゃあまあ、カラオケおごってやるわっつーてぇ」
lines.english: “So I figured I'd find some way to cheer her up. Right then, this guy out front of a karaoke place calls to us. So I go, fine, karaoke's on me.”

lines.japanese: 「や、そらァもう俺は弾けたぜ？　自分で歌うのはシャウト系オンリー。あいつが歌えばタンバリン叩いてマラカス振って、ハイハイ叫んでガンガン跳ねて──ああ、あと黄色い声でコーラス付けたね適当だけど」
lines.english: “Oh, I went wild, believe me. Sang nothing but shouty stuff. Whenever she sang, I beat the tambourine, shook the maracas, hollered along, bounced all over—and, yeah, threw in this shrill backing chorus. Mostly made it up.”

lines.japanese: やつは背中を丸めたまま、体を揺すったり両手を振ったりして言葉を続けた。
lines.english: Still hunched over, he continued while rocking his body and waving both hands.

lines.japanese: 「そんな感じで一時間ぐれー騒いでさ、俺ちょっとションベンしに便所行ったんだよ。で戻ってきたらなに、蛎崎うにの新曲流れてっけど亜衣ぜんぜん歌ってなくて、なんかすんすん泣いてんじゃん」
lines.english: “We carried on like that for an hour or so, then I went to take a piss. I come back and Kakizaki Uni's new song is playing, except Ai isn't singing. She's just sitting there sniffling.”

lines.japanese: 「まあ、これでも俺ソラ学だし、いちお馬鹿ではねーのよ。最近のあいつ見てて、泣いてる理由なんてだいたいお察ししてるわけ。そもそもあいつ、俺が迎え行くまで成田といたわけだし──」
lines.english: “Look, I go to Misora Academy. I'm not a complete moron. Watching her lately, I had a decent idea why she was crying. She'd been with you right up until I picked her up—”

lines.japanese: 森里がじろりと俺を盗み見た。俺は黙ってその眼光を受けとめた。俺には見せたことがない亜衣の涙を思うと、いつものようにすっとぼけた振りで茶化すことは出来なかった。
lines.english: Morisato stole a sharp glance at me. I met it in silence. Thinking of the tears Ai had never shown me, I could not play dumb and joke the way I usually would.

lines.japanese: 「で、俺どうしたらいいのよって困っちゃってぇ。隣り座って肩でも抱くかァ？とか一瞬思ったけど、いやそれも臭ぇじゃん。だから、とりあえずこう、こんな、直角に座ってさ」
lines.english: “So there I am wondering what the hell I'm supposed to do. For a second I think, sit beside her, put an arm around her? Nah, too corny. So I sit like this instead. At a right angle.”

lines.japanese: やつはそのときの自分を再現するように、椅子の縁ぎりぎりまで身を乗りだしてテーブルへ片肘を預けた。
lines.english: Reenacting the moment, he leaned to the very edge of his seat and planted one elbow on the table.

lines.japanese: 「お嬢さん、なんか悩みあんなら俺様が聞くぜぇ、みたいな感じで話振って──」
lines.english: “I go, ‘Young lady, if something's troubling you, the great Kazuma will hear you out,’ and steer the conversation that way—”

lines.japanese: しかし、すぐにまた腕を下ろして座りなおす。
lines.english: But he immediately lowered his arm and sat back.

lines.japanese: 「──言ったんだけど、でも、なんも話してくんなくて」
lines.english: “—or I tried, but she wouldn't tell me anything.”

lines.japanese: 「そんであいつ、なんでもないとか言っちゃってムリクリ笑ってんの。ごめんぴーとか言って、マイク持って鼻声で歌いだすのよ。エ～だろ？　エ～なんだよこの空気って感じじゃん。痛々しい、もらい泣くっつうの」
lines.english: “Then she says it’s nothing and forces this smile. Goes, ‘Sorreee,’ picks up the mic, starts singing through her nose. You know? Like, what the hell is with this mood? It hurts to watch. Makes you want to cry with her.”

lines.japanese: 酔っぱらって饒舌になったおっさんみたいな調子で、やつは大袈裟に顔をしかめたり傾けたりしながら話しつづける。
lines.english: He rambled on like a drunk old man who had found his tongue, tilting and contorting his face for emphasis.

lines.japanese: 「でー、まぁほら、俺もいままで十何年間？　その、長いことコレっつうタイミングを待ってたわけじゃん。いや、長過ぎだけどさ、しょーがねンだよ。なまじ仲良すぎちゃうと、そーゆーのなかなか掴めねえんだよ」
lines.english: “And, well, how long had I been waiting for this? Ten-something years? I'd been waiting forever for the moment. Way too long, yeah, but what could I do? Get too close to somebody and you can never find the opening for that stuff.”

lines.japanese: 「だもんでずるずる十何年間来ちゃったわけだけどさあ、いや、さすがにここかァ？思って。男見せる瞬間来たかァ？思って。そらまあギュッと行きますわなあ、マイクごと」
lines.english: “So I let it drag on for ten-something years. But this time I think, is this it? Is this where I finally show I'm a man? So, yeah, I pull her in tight. Microphone and all.”

lines.japanese: テーブルの下で小さく、しかし力強くふたつのこぶしが握りしめられた。
lines.english: Beneath the table, two fists clenched small but hard.

lines.japanese: 「向こう、え、え、って感じだったけど、まあ、はっきりした抵抗みたいのはなくてさ」
lines.english: “She's going, ‘Huh? What?’ but she doesn't exactly resist.”

lines.japanese: 「で、なんかいい匂いとかするし、そしたらおまえ、ドーパミンどぱどぱで、頭クラクラ的な展開になってくんじゃん。だからあんま覚えてねーんだけど、わりと告ったっつーか。まあそう、ぶっちゃけ告ったわけよ」
lines.english: “And she smells good, right, so suddenly the dopamine's pouring out and my head's spinning. I don't remember it too clearly, but I basically told her. Yeah. Flat-out confessed.”

lines.japanese: 照れくさそうにはにかんだ顔には、自虐と後悔の色が窺えた。
lines.english: His bashful smile carried shades of self-mockery and regret.

lines.japanese: 「そしたら、ちょっと無言の間ァあってさ……」
lines.english: “Then there's this little silence...”

lines.japanese: 「んで、あいつこう、俺の体ゆっくり押しかえして。ごめん好きなひといるから──とか、ぬかしましたわ」
lines.english: “And she slowly pushes me back and says, ‘Sorry, there's somebody I like.’”

lines.japanese: 「いやいやいや待てって。待ちなさいって。そんなん知ってますがな。知ってて言ってんだっちゅーの。なあ？」
lines.english: “No, no, no, wait. Hold on. I know that. Obviously I know that. I'm telling you even though I know, okay?”

lines.japanese: 自分語りの途中で、いきなり森里が相槌を求めて視線を上げてきた。俺はなにも答えず、ぴくりとも動かなかった。やつは鼻を鳴らしてそっぽを向いた。
lines.english: In the middle of his monologue, Morisato abruptly looked up for agreement. I said nothing and did not move a fraction. He snorted and turned away.

lines.japanese: 「──で、そんなことンなっちゃったからさー。も、あいつすんげえ、ちょお申しわけなさげな顔しててー。え、なんだよ、イジメ？　俺イジメっ子？　みたいな。いわば俺、被害者兼、加害者ですわもう」
lines.english: “—and once that's happened, she gets this unbelievably apologetic look. I'm thinking, what is this, bullying? Am I the bully now? So there I am: victim and perpetrator both.”

lines.japanese: 深夜のバラエティ番組へ駆りだされた若手芸人みたいに、森里は声を張り、ふんだんな身振りを添えて情感たっぷりに語る。
lines.english: Like a young comic hauled onto a late-night variety show, Morisato raised his voice and told the story with lavish emotion and extravagant gestures.

lines.japanese: べつに手を抜いたって客席が冷えるわけでも仕事が減るわけでもないのに、なんでこの男はいつもこんな風に疲れる喋り方をするんだろう。なんでいつもそんなに気を遣ってるんだろう。
lines.english: The crowd wouldn't go cold and the jobs wouldn't dry up if he eased off for once. Why did this man always talk in a way that exhausted him? Why was he forever working so hard at it?

lines.japanese: それはたぶん、鷲介が意図して相手から攻撃的な言葉を引きださせたり、鳴が言葉の端々に天然を装ったユーモアを挟んだりするのと同じことなんだろう。
lines.english: It was probably the same thing Shusuke did when he deliberately baited people into attacking him, or Naru when she slipped humor disguised as innocence between her words.

lines.japanese: みんなひとりが恐いんだ。ひとに去られるのが恐いんだ。
lines.english: Everyone was afraid of being alone. Afraid of being left behind.

lines.japanese: 「つうかさー、俺、あいつアゲてやるためにカラオケ連れてきたんだぜ？　さらに落としてどーすんだよって話じゃん」
lines.english: “And come on, I brought her to karaoke to cheer her up. What am I doing making her feel worse?”

lines.japanese: 「そらもう、そっからは俄然ブチ上げてくしかねーだろ。俺『なーんて冗談ぴー！』とか言って速攻キャンセルかけて。したら向こうも『だよねーアハハー、マジレスしちゃったー』とか言って一件落着？」
lines.english: “So then I've got no choice but to crank the mood all the way back up. I cancel the whole thing on the spot: ‘Juuust kidding!’ Then she goes, ‘Right? Ahaha, I took you seriously!’ Case closed?”

lines.japanese: 「まー俺も大概チキンだけどさ、いやだって、そんときまだ朝まで時間あったし、マジあのビミョーな空気にはぜってー耐えらんねって。ほんとハンパねーから。そりゃ亜衣だってそそくさと便所しけこむわ」
lines.english: “Sure, I'm a world-class chicken. But morning was still hours away, and there was no way in hell I could survive that atmosphere. It was brutal. No wonder Ai made a beeline for the bathroom.”

lines.japanese: 森里は腰を浮かし、テーブルに放置されていた飲み残しのクリアカップへ手を伸ばした。呷ってでっかい氷をひとつ頬張ると、嘲笑を浮かべる表情が片側にぼっこり膨らんだ。
lines.english: Morisato raised himself from the chair and reached for a half-finished plastic cup abandoned on the table. He tipped it up and took a large ice cube into his mouth, swelling one side of his sneering face.

lines.japanese: 「んで俺ひとり──」
lines.english: “So I'm alone—”

lines.japanese: 口に氷を入れたまま喋ろうとしたが、やはり話しづらかったらしくペッとカップに戻した。
lines.english: He tried to talk around the ice, found it difficult after all, and spat it back into the cup.

lines.japanese: 「んで俺ひとりカラオケ部屋に取り残されたんだけど、歌本めくったって、んなもんおまえ、頭入るわけねーじゃん」
lines.english: “So I'm left alone in the karaoke room, but even if I flip through the songbook, there's no way any of it gets into my head.”

lines.japanese: 「そりゃそうだろ。俺もう、くあーってなってんだよ、くあーって。匂いとか感触残っててむっちゃくあーだし、一方じゃ『やってもうたー』でくあーだし、とにかく色々アレだよ、色々くあーなんだよ」
lines.english: “Well, obviously. Inside I'm going graaah. Just graaah. Her smell and the feel of her are still there, so that's one graaah; meanwhile I'm thinking, ‘I really did it now,’ so that's another. Everything's... you know. Graaah. All of it.”

lines.japanese: やつは十本の指を逆立てて「くあー」な心情を古典的なジェスチャーで表現した。
lines.english: He splayed all ten fingers and illustrated his ‘graaah’ emotions with the classic gesture.

lines.japanese: 「も、悲しンだか恥ずかしンだかワケわかんねっつの。頭くあー掻きむしったり、バッコンバッコン椅子殴ったりすんだけど、そんでもぜんぜん落ちつかねーでさ、ずっと胸バクバク言っていいかげん息、苦しいのよ」
lines.english: “I can't even tell if I'm sad or humiliated. I'm clawing at my head, graaah, pounding the chair over and over, but I can't settle down. My heart won't stop hammering, and after a while I can barely breathe.”

lines.japanese: 心臓のあたりを上から鷲づかみして、大袈裟に顔をしかめている。
lines.english: He clutched dramatically at the area over his heart and screwed up his face.

lines.japanese: 「だから俺、ピルケース開けてさ。も、しょーがねえからハルで寝ちゃうかー思って。リアル狸寝入りなんつーのもアリかなー思って。えー、でも俺が先に寝たらあいつ暇すっかなあ──」
lines.english: “So I open my pill case. Figure, screw it, I'll take some Halcion and sleep. Maybe actually pretending to sleep could work. Except if I fall asleep first, won't she get bored—”

lines.japanese: 「──とかなんとかボケボケ考えながら、それグラスん中に、なんとなーく落としてみたんだわ」
lines.english: “—and while I'm vaguely turning all that stupid crap over, I kind of drop one into the glass.”

lines.japanese: やつは右手を持ちあげ、くっついていた親指と人差し指をぱっと離した。その指で宙を突付きながら話を続ける。
lines.english: He raised his right hand and flicked apart the thumb and forefinger that had touched. Poking those fingers through the air, he continued.

lines.japanese: 「な。そしたらシュワシュワいって泡吹いて溶けてくじゃん。えー、なんか綺麗ー、おもすれーつって、なんとな～く一個二個三個？」
lines.english: “Right? It starts fizzing and foaming and dissolving. I'm like, oh, pretty, that's neat, and then, without really thinking—one, two, three?”

lines.japanese: 「んーでも心臓は相変わらずバクバクいってるし、頭はくあーって、ボケてんだか冴えてんだか分かんねーような状態でぇ。で、そこにおまえ、亜衣が戻ってくんだけどさ」
lines.english: “But my heart's still pounding, my head's still graaah, and I can't tell if I'm dazed or razor-sharp. Then Ai comes back.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、たぶんあいつはあいつで、いろいろ便座の上で考えてきたと思うんだけど──うん、そう、考えなしじゃなかったと思うんだけど──なんつーかなあ、そっからあいつの話にやたら成田が絡んできてさあ」
lines.english: “She'd probably spent the whole time on the toilet thinking through plenty of things herself—yeah, I don't think she came back with no plan at all—but then somehow you start turning up in everything she says.”

lines.japanese: 「でもソレって、俺からしたら正直ビミョーじゃん。ビミョーっつうかナシじゃん。アウトじゃん。勘弁してくれって感じじゃん」
lines.english: “And honestly, from where I'm sitting, that's rough. No, worse than rough. That's a no. That's out. Like, give me a break.”

lines.japanese: 「もうアレね、無意識にっつーか。もうアレほんと、ムカツクとかセツネエとか通りこして、俺はナチュラルに思っちゃった訳よ。あー成田いなくなってくんねーかなあ、なんて。そしたら無意識にこうですよ」
lines.english: “By then it isn't even conscious. I'm past pissed off, past heartsick. I just find myself thinking, man, I wish Narita would disappear. And then my hand does this.”

lines.japanese: 森里は白々しく真横を向きながら、テーブルの上のクリアカップを俺の方へ滑らせてみせた。一晩前のリプレイのつもりか。
lines.english: Turning ostentatiously aside, Morisato slid the plastic cup across the table toward me. A reenactment of the night before.

lines.japanese: 俺は差しだされたカップを掴んで、中身をやつの顔面にぶちまけた。長い髪が縁取る表情に当たって、数個の氷がばらばらと落ちていった。
lines.english: I caught the proffered cup and flung its contents into his face. Ice struck the expression framed by his long hair and clattered away in several directions.

lines.japanese: 森里は濡れた頬を袖で拭いながら俺を見た。笑っている。俺は無言で睨みかえした。やつはたしかに笑っていたけれど、疲れきって憔悴しているようにも見えた。頼りない黒目が逃げてゆく。
lines.english: Morisato wiped his wet cheek with his sleeve and looked at me, smiling. I glared back without a word. It was unmistakably a smile, yet he looked drained to the marrow. His uncertain dark eyes fled from mine.

lines.japanese: 「まあ、つうか、その前からＲ－ウィングに情報リークしたりはしてたんだけどさ。マジネタ・ガセネタ織りまぜて色々……うん、なんてかまあ……」
lines.english: “Well, I mean, I'd already been leaking information to R-Wing before then. All kinds of stuff, mixing real tips with fake ones... Yeah, I guess...”

lines.japanese: 「やつらを煽って、俺を殺させようとした。だろ？」
lines.english: “You egged them on and tried to get them to kill me. Right?”

lines.japanese: やつが語尾を濁そうとしたので、俺が後を継いでやった。すると、疲れきった道化の眼が呆けたように広がった。
lines.english: He tried to let the sentence trail off, so I finished it for him. The tired clown's eyes widened blankly.
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「いやいや、馬鹿、おっかねーこと言うなよ。だから言ってんだろ、俺みたいな半端モンにそんな度胸ねえんだって」
lines.english: “No, no, idiot. Don’t say scary shit like that. I’ve told you, a half-assed bastard like me hasn’t got the nerve.”

lines.japanese: 「なに。違うの」
lines.english: “What? That's not it?”

lines.japanese: 「違げーよ。だって、あんじゃん。殺さなくたっておまえを──成田隼人を消す方法はさぁ」
lines.english: “Nah, that’s not it. I mean, there is a way, right? A way to erase you—Hayato Narita—without killing you.”

lines.japanese: 気だるげに、しかしどこか得意げに、森里和馬は表情を斜に構えた。
lines.english: Kazuma Morisato gave me a languid, faintly smug look from the corner of his eyes.

lines.japanese: 「おまえに自覚あんのかは知らねーけど、俺は翔さんから聞いて知ってるぜ？」
lines.english: “I don't know whether you realize it yourself, but Kakeru told me all about it.”

lines.japanese: 「なにを」
lines.english: “About what?”

lines.japanese: 相手に頬を向け、流し目で見下ろすような仕草。それは心酔する鳳翔を模倣しているつもりなのか。
lines.english: He turned one cheek toward me and looked down his nose from the corner of his eye. Was he trying to imitate Kakeru Otori, the man he worshiped?

lines.japanese: 「おまえらン中の誰かがブチ切れてメーター振っきると、ガルーダとかってヤベえの出てきて、その体はそいつひとりに乗っ取られんだろ？」
lines.english: “If one of you snaps hard enough to bury the needle, this dangerous guy called Garuda comes out and takes the body for himself. Right?”

lines.japanese: 森里の唇が弱々しく吊りあがった。瞳孔の開ききったあるじのそれと違って、臆病な草食動物のげっぷみたいだった。
lines.english: Morisato's lips curled weakly. Unlike the smile of his master, pupils blown wide, it looked like a timid herbivore trying to belch.

lines.japanese: 「……おまえも知ってたのか」
lines.english: “...You knew too?”

lines.japanese: 俺は無意識のうちに止まっていた呼吸を再開した。
lines.english: I resumed the breathing I had unconsciously stopped.

lines.japanese: 「知ってるよ。おまえのその体ン中、成田隼人以外にも何人か入ってんだろ？　ハッ、そりゃ知ってるっつーの。だって俺、一年とき羽田鷹志と同級だぜ」
lines.english: “Of course I knew. There are several people inside that body besides Hayato Narita, right? Ha! Obviously I knew. I was in Takashi Haneda's class our first year.”

lines.japanese: 俺は仰けぞるように頭を倒し、まぶた越しにも容赦なく染みこんでくる凶暴な照明に息を吹きつけた。
lines.english: I let my head fall back and breathed against the savage light that seeped mercilessly through my eyelids.

lines.japanese: 「しかも、かなり懐かれてるし。森里くーん、なんつって」
lines.english: “And he's pretty attached to me. ‘Morisato!’ and all that.”

lines.japanese: そう言えばこいつの制服姿なんて見たことなかったけど、たしかにアタマのいい坊っちゃん校だって言ってた。美空学園だったのか。
lines.english: Come to think of it, I had never seen this guy in uniform, but he had said he attended some rich-kid school for smart students. So it was Misora Academy.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあおまえ最初から」
lines.english: “Then from the very beginning, you—”

lines.japanese: 首を起こしながら質すと、森里は細長く口を開けたとぼけヅラで「あー」と頷いた。
lines.english: As I raised my head to question him, Morisato opened his mouth into a long, vacant ‘Ah,’ and nodded.

lines.japanese: 「うん、知ってた。もちろん、初めておまえが翔さん達にでけぇクチ利いてんの見たときは、あの気ィ弱えー羽田クンがなんの冗談だって目ぇ疑ったよ。マジ、ポカーンだよ」
lines.english: “Yeah, I knew. First time I saw you mouthing off to Kakeru and the others, sure, I couldn't believe my eyes. Timid little Haneda acting like that? What kind of joke was this? Seriously, my jaw dropped.”

lines.japanese: 「──ていう話をさ、何気なく翔さんに報告すんじゃん、あいつ学校じゃ全然っすよみたいに。そしたらいきなり、羽田の中には複数の人格が共存してるーみたいな話聞かされて。そこでまたポカーンだけど」
lines.english: “—so I casually report it to Kakeru, right? Tell him the guy's nothing like that at school. Then, out of nowhere, he tells me several personalities coexist inside Haneda. Jaw hits the floor all over again.”

lines.japanese: 俺は後ろ頭をがしがし掻きながら、長い長い息を吐いた。ぜんぶ吐きおえたあとは、細かい舌打ちをしつこく飽きるまで繰りかえした。くそ、くそ、くそ、くそっ！
lines.english: Scratching hard at the back of my head, I let out a very, very long breath. Once it was all gone, I clicked my tongue in short bursts until I finally tired of it. Shit, shit, shit, shit!

lines.japanese: 「だって、そりゃポカーンだろ。おまえら各自で、てめえのツラどんな風にイメージしてっか知らねーけどさ、外から見りゃ羽田も成田もフツーにおんなじ顔だぜ？　まあ、声とか喋り方はだいぶ違ってっけど」
lines.english: “Of course my jaw dropped. I don't know what kind of face each of you imagines he has, but from the outside, Haneda and Narita are just the same face. Your voices and the way you talk are pretty different, though.”

lines.japanese: がしがし、がしがし──俺は後頭部で上下する腕の振り幅をがんがん大きくしていって、最後にはくしゃくしゃに掻きまわした。
lines.english: Scratch, scratch, scratch—my arm swept higher and harder across the back of my head until I was raking my hair into chaos.

lines.japanese: 「てめえ、じゃあよ、なんで黙ってんだよ。知ってんなら知ってるって言えよ。一生懸命隠して馬鹿みてえじゃねえか俺」
lines.english: “Then why the hell did you keep quiet? If you knew, say you knew. I was breaking my back to hide it, looking like a complete idiot.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、だって言うなって、翔さんに口止めされてたもん」
lines.english: “Because Kakeru told me not to say anything.”

lines.japanese: 「なんで」
lines.english: “Why?”

lines.japanese: 「よく知らねーけど、アレなんだろ、なんか。おまえらみたい存在って、めっちゃデリケートなんだろ？　俺はそう聞いてたけど。ちょっと間違えて詰めこみすぎると、すぐしっちゃかめっちゃかンなっちゃうって」
lines.english: “I don't really know, but it's that, right? Beings like you are super delicate? That's what I heard. Stuff too much in the wrong way and the whole thing falls to pieces.”

lines.japanese: 意味ありげな言葉を小出しにちらつかてきたニワトリを思いだす。やつは細心の注意を払って俺の──俺たちの出方を探っていたんだ。
lines.english: I remembered the Chicken, dangling suggestive scraps before me one by one. He had been feeling out my reactions—our reactions—with exquisite care.

lines.japanese: くそっ！　てのひらの上で踊らされていたようで屈辱だ。俺は目を閉じ、深呼吸して唱える。世界が平和でありますように。
lines.english: Shit. The humiliation of having danced in the palm of his hand. I closed my eyes, drew a deep breath, and recited: *May peace prevail on Earth*.

lines.japanese: 「もう俺ＹＦＢクビだから、ぶっちゃけるけどさ。翔さんが俺らとツルんでたのは、要するに暇つぶしみてーなもんだったんだよ。結局んとこあのひとは、ガルーダってやつに再会すんのをずっと待ってるだけなの」
lines.english: “I'm out of YFB now, so I'll tell you straight. Kakeru hanging around us was basically something to kill time. In the end, all that man was doing was waiting to meet Garuda again.”

lines.japanese: 「だからおまえらにヘタ打って、そいつ、そのガルーダってのに消えてほしくなかったんだろ。翔さんが成田に付きまとったり、俺に羽田の様子をちょくちょく聞いたりしてたのも……まあ、要は監視だよな」
lines.english: “He didn't want you people screwing up and making Garuda disappear. Kakeru following Narita around, asking me every so often how Haneda was doing... Call it what it was: surveillance.”

lines.japanese: 「監視だァ……？」
lines.english: “Surveillance...?”

lines.japanese: 気に喰わない。腑に落ちない。癪に障る。
lines.english: I didn't like it. It didn't sit right. It got under my skin.

lines.japanese: 鳳のアホが、あのガルーダだか伽楼羅だかいうアホと、アホ同士で気が合うっつーのは想像に難くない。そりゃあ、あのふたりが並べばさぞかし愉快なクレイジー漫談が繰りひろげられることだろう。
lines.english: It was easy enough to imagine that idiot Otori hitting it off with the idiot called Garuda, or Karura, or whatever. Put the two of them together and they could stage one hell of a lunatic double act.

lines.japanese: だが、なぜやつは伽楼羅のことを知っている？　森里がたまたまタカシと同級だったのとはわけが違う。あいつの存在は、俺でさえ知らなかったことなのに。
lines.english: But how did Otori know about Karura? This was nothing like Morisato happening to be in Takashi's class. Even I hadn't known he existed.

lines.japanese: 「なあ」
lines.english: “Hey.”

lines.japanese: 森里に呼ばれて俺は我に返った。
lines.english: Morisato's voice brought me back.

lines.japanese: 「実際んトコどうなん。マジでおまえらキレると、ガルーダっつうのに替わっちゃうの」
lines.english: “So what's it really like? One of you seriously loses his temper and you switch over to this Garuda guy?”

lines.japanese: 「知らねえよ。ひとをＳＦ扱いすんな」
lines.english: “How should I know? Don't treat me like science fiction.”

lines.japanese: 俺は森里が座っている椅子の下を蹴った。やつは慌てて座面を掴んで、そのあと尻を浮かせて座りなおした。
lines.english: I kicked the base of Morisato's chair. He hurriedly seized the seat, then lifted his rear and settled himself again.

lines.japanese: 「翔さんはさぁ、よく『成田隼人は怒りという感情を失くした男だ』なーんつってたんだけどー」
lines.english: “Kakeru used to say, ‘Hayato Narita is a man who has lost the emotion called anger.’”

lines.japanese: 「でも俺はさ、いやソレちょっと違うんじゃないかなって、実はずっと思ってたんだよな。なんか成田って、俺に似てるとこあっからさ」
lines.english: “But I always thought that wasn't quite it. There are parts of you that remind me of myself, Narita.”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「ほら、俺らみたいのって、どーでもいい他人のことはホントどーでもいいとしか思えねーんだけど、そんかし身内同志の慣れ合い意識みてーのは、ものっそい強ええじゃん。友達少ない反動か何か知んねーけど」
lines.english: “See, people like us seriously couldn’t care less about random strangers, but we get crazy attached to our own, right? Maybe it’s ’cause we don’t have many friends or something. Who knows.”

lines.japanese: 「うるせえよ。分析するな、俺を分析するな」
lines.english: “Shut up. Don't analyze me. Stop analyzing me.”

lines.japanese: 「そんな感じだからさ。まあ、翔さんは夢にも思わなかったみたいだけど、俺はずっと思ってたんだよ」
lines.english: “That's what I mean. Kakeru never dreamed of it, but I always thought—”

lines.japanese: 「成田怒らしてーなら、んな、本人にちょっかい出すとかじゃなくて、あいつのツレとかやっちゃえば一発なんじゃね？　みたいな」
lines.english: “—if you wanted to get Narita mad, why bother messing with him? Just do something to one of his buddies and you’d get him in one shot, right? Something like that.”

lines.japanese: 「ま、そんなん教えちゃったら、あのひとホントにやりかねねーじゃん。だから黙ってたけど。な、感謝しろよ成田」
lines.english: “But tell Kakeru that and he might actually do it. So I kept my mouth shut. Be grateful, Narita.”

lines.japanese: 森里は両腕を頭の後ろに添えて、首を左右にほぐし始めた。
lines.english: Morisato placed both hands behind his head and began loosening his neck from side to side.

lines.japanese: 「なにが感謝だ。結局てめえでやってんじゃねえか」
lines.english: “Thank you for what? You went and did it yourself in the end.”

lines.japanese: 「あァ……そうだ、この前、うちのおかんがさ」
lines.english: “Oh... Right. The other day, my mom...”

lines.japanese: やつは唐突に話題を変えた。やけに自虐的な調子だ。
lines.english: He abruptly changed the subject, his tone strangely self-mocking.

lines.japanese: 「えっと、なんだ、パート先の？　友達の？　娘っつったかな？　よく覚えてねーけど、なんかそのねーちゃんが、結婚して出産したんだって。でその孫が、まだ生後１ヵ月とか、そんぐらいらしいんだけど」
lines.english: “What was it? A friend from her part-time job? That friend's daughter, I think? I don't remember. Anyway, this woman got married and had a baby. The grandkid is only about a month old.”

lines.japanese: 「その赤ん坊がさ、検査したら、えーとなんだっけ……なんとかっていうひでえ難病にかかってることが分かっちゃって。マジでもう、大きくなっても一生入院生活って、ほぼ確定しちゃってんだって」
lines.english: “They ran tests on the baby and found some awful rare disease—forget what it was called. Apparently it's all but certain the kid will spend its whole life in the hospital, even after it grows up.”

lines.japanese: 「その話聞いたときさ、俺、我ながらやべえと思うんだけど──ホント、でも一瞬、思っちゃったんだよね。え、ソレ産みなおした方がよくね？って」
lines.english: “When I heard that—and I know how awful this is—I honestly thought it for a second. Wouldn't it be better to reset and have another one?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、そんなこと思った瞬間ぞっとしたけどさ。だって、色々真剣に考えさせられたあとの選択肢のひとつとしてならまだしもだぜ、真っ先に素でそんなん思っちゃったんだかんね」
lines.english: “The instant I thought it, I scared myself. If it came up as one option after you’d seriously thought the whole thing through, that’d be one thing. But it was the first thought that came to me, without even trying.”

lines.japanese: 「これもまた朝のワイドショーで、だっちーの横のメガネが言ってたんだけどー、こういうのアレ、ゲーム世代のリセット感覚って言うらしいよ」
lines.english: “That glasses guy next to Datchi said on a morning talk show that this is what they call the ‘reset mentality’ of the video-game generation.”

lines.japanese: 「うるせえよ糞ロンゲ。悪かったな、俺リセットかかんなくて」
lines.english: “Shut up, you long-haired piece of shit. Sorry I don't come with a reset button.”

lines.japanese: 「な。こんだけいろんなもん無駄にして、けっきょく出てねえもんなガルーダ」
lines.english: “Right? You threw all this stuff away, and Garuda still never came out.”

lines.japanese: 「挙句におまえ、俺が帰ってきたらホッとしてるしな」
lines.english: “And after all that, you were relieved when I came back.”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？　なんでだよ、してねーよ馬鹿」
lines.english: “Huh? Why would I be? I wasn't, idiot.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、してたじゃん──ま、どっちでもいいけど」
lines.english: “You were. But whatever.”

lines.japanese: 森里が伸びをしながら椅子から下りた。二本の脚で立って、嘘くさいあくびをしている。
lines.english: Morisato stretched as he got down from the chair. Standing on his own two feet, he gave an unconvincing yawn.

lines.japanese: 「ふぁ～あ……さ、て、と」
lines.english: “Haaaah... Well, then.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ俺、とりあえず大司教ンとこ行ってケジメ付けてくるわ」
lines.english: “All right, then. Guess I'll go see the Archbishop and settle things.”

lines.japanese: 出掛けに一日の予定を家族へ伝えるような、そんな気の抜けた口調でやつは言った。
lines.english: He said it with the listless tone of someone telling his family his plans before stepping out for the day.

lines.japanese: 「カラスやったの成田じゃなくて俺でしたーっつって、軽く自首してくんよ。他にいい落とし前の付け方、思いつかねーし。そんなんでいい？」
lines.english: “I’ll go turn myself in. Tell him I was the one who attacked Crow, not Narita. Can’t think of a better way to pay what I owe. That good enough?”

lines.japanese: あの泣きだしそうないじけた笑顔。
lines.english: That sullen smile on the verge of tears.

lines.japanese: 「……あのオウム頭、マジ頭イッてんぞ」
lines.english: “...That parrot-head is completely insane.”

lines.japanese: 俺はやつの問いに答えず、やつの覚悟を問うた。
lines.english: Instead of answering his question, I questioned his resolve.

lines.japanese: 「おまえ、殺されんじゃねーの」
lines.english: “He might kill you.”

lines.japanese: 「ハッ……そんな、言うなよわざわざ」
lines.english: “Ha... You don't have to say it out loud.”

lines.japanese: 震えるような声。肩に触れる長い髪の毛先が揺れた。
lines.english: His voice trembled. So did the long ends of hair touching his shoulders.

lines.japanese: 「だって、そうでもしねえと収集つかねーだろ、フレイムバーズもＲ－ウィングも。あと、俺自身も？」
lines.english: “Because if I don't, none of this gets settled. Not the Flame Birds, not R-Wing. Not me, either. I guess?”

lines.japanese: 「ああそう」
lines.english: “Oh. Right.”

lines.japanese: そこまで言えるなら大した度胸だ。俺はあえて、それに関して口を挟むのをやめた。
lines.english: If he could say that, he had real nerve. I chose not to interfere any further.

lines.japanese: しかし実際のところ、いまさらあのオウム頭の狂人に相まみえるのは困難だろう。やつはもはや敵にも仲間にも姿を見せず、今宵、聖地におわす神の御許にさえ現れなかった。
lines.english: In truth, meeting that parrot-headed madman now would be difficult. He no longer showed himself to enemy or ally, and tonight he had failed to appear even before the god who reigned over their holy ground.

lines.japanese: 俺はこう考えている。たぶん、あの男はもう──
lines.english: This was what I thought: the man was probably already—

lines.japanese: 「なあ、その前におまえも、気ィ済むまで殴ってけよ」
lines.english: “Hey. Before I go, you should hit me till you feel better.”

lines.japanese: 森里は古い青春映画の外タレみたいにいったん両手を広げ、そのあと右手で自分の頬を軽く打って俺を誘った。
lines.english: Like some foreign actor in an old youth movie, Morisato spread his arms, then patted his own cheek and invited me to take a swing.

lines.japanese: 「……ああ、まあ、そうだな」
lines.english: “...Yeah. Sure.”

lines.japanese: 俺は言われるがまま、テーブルに手をついて重々しく腰を上げた。
lines.english: At his prompting, I planted a hand on the table and rose heavily.

lines.japanese: 俺と大して変わらない身長の真向かいに立つ。やつは余裕ぶっこいて目を逸らさなかったが、奥歯を強く噛みしめているのが顎の下の強張りで分かった。
lines.english: I stood directly before him, almost the same height. He met my eyes with studied composure, but the stiffness beneath his jaw betrayed how hard he was clenching his molars.

lines.japanese: 俺はやつの襟に手をかけ、その顔面めがけ大袈裟にこぶしをかざした。ガラスの向こうで背の高い白人の女がぎょっと目を剥いて、慌てて連れの男の肩を叩いていた。
lines.english: I seized his collar and raised my fist theatrically toward his face. Beyond the glass, a tall white woman's eyes widened. She hurriedly tapped her male companion on the shoulder.

lines.japanese: 「じゃ、行くぞ」
lines.english: “All right. Here it comes.”

lines.japanese: 「……おめ、いちいち断んなよ。女にキスするときもそんなんか？　ダセぇなあ」
lines.english: “...You announce every little thing? You ask permission before you kiss a girl, too? That's pathetic.”

lines.japanese: 「うるさいよ童貞」
lines.english: “Shut up, virgin.”

lines.japanese: 森里はしゃらくさい台詞を吐いて強がった。俺は眉間に皺を寄せてそのツラを眺めた。ガラス越しに俺たちを観察するギャラリーが増えていた。
lines.english: Morisato tried to bluff it out with a smart remark. I frowned and studied his face. More spectators were gathering beyond the glass.

lines.japanese: 俺は……ふっと息を横に捨てて腕を下ろした。
lines.english: I... blew one short breath aside and lowered my arm.

lines.japanese: 「いや……いいや。やっぱいいや。店員さんとかに怒られちゃうから」
lines.english: “No... Forget it. The staff might get mad.”

lines.japanese: 「ハ、ハァ？」
lines.english: “H-huh?”

lines.japanese: 「つーかさ、おまえ女にフラれたんだろ。だっせ。俺そんなん殴ったら、なんか伝染りそうじゃん。なんかアレ、失恋菌みたいの」
lines.english: “Besides, some girl dumped you, right? Lame. If I hit you I might catch it. You know—the heartbreak bug.”

lines.japanese: 「やだよ、冗談じゃねえよ。縁起でもねえ、俺だって近々告白とかする予定あんだから」
lines.english: “No way. I'm planning to confess to somebody myself before long. I don't need that kind of bad luck.”

lines.japanese: 森里の襟を放した左手に、細い息を二回吹きつける。半ば呆けてる怪訝な目を無視して、俺は群がりかけた野次馬に睨みを効かせて解散させた。
lines.english: I released his collar and blew twice across my left hand. Ignoring his dazed, baffled stare, I glared the gathering onlookers back into the crowd.

lines.japanese: そのまま、やつに横顔を向けたまま、俺は聞こえても聞こえなくてもどうでもいい声量で告げた。
lines.english: Still giving him only my profile, I spoke at a volume I didn't care whether he heard.

lines.japanese: 「あとさ、アレじゃん。友達殴ったらこっちだってヤな気分になんじゃん。なんで俺、被害者なのにこれ以上ヤな気分になんなきゃなんねーんだよ」
lines.english: “Besides, hitting a friend would make me feel like shit too. I'm the victim here. Why should I have to feel even worse?”

lines.japanese: 崩れそうな声が返ってきた。俺は部屋の隅に置きすてたスポーツバッグを拾いあげて肩へかける。
lines.english: His answering voice sounded ready to crumble. I retrieved the sports bag abandoned in the corner and slung it over my shoulder.

lines.japanese: 「はあ？　なんだよ、おまえ……」
lines.english: “What? What the hell are you...”

lines.japanese: 「なんだよそれ、だって俺、おまえを……」
lines.english: “What's that supposed to mean? I tried to...”

lines.japanese: 大音響の音楽の下、どこかから鼻声みたいな変な音が聞こえた。
lines.english: Beneath the thunder of the music, a strange sound came from somewhere—a nasal little whine.

lines.japanese: 「成田…………ごめん」
lines.english: “Narita... I'm sorry.”

lines.japanese: 俺は舌の先で頬の裏を突いた。変な声。小指を耳の穴に挿しいれ、ねじり、その先端に息を吹きかけた。
lines.english: I prodded the inside of my cheek with my tongue. Weird voice. I stuck my little finger in my ear, twisted it, then blew over the tip.

lines.japanese: 「俺に言われてもな」
lines.english: “No use apologizing to me.”

lines.japanese: 俺は歩きだした。変な鼻声がまだなにか喋ってたみたいだけど、情が移ったら嫌だから、さっさと踊る群衆の中へ埋もれることに──
lines.english: I started walking. The strange nasal voice seemed to go on talking, but I did not want to start feeling sorry for him. I hurried to lose myself in the dancing crowd—
“Oh.”

lines.japanese: ──そうだ。ふと思いだして、俺はドアのノブを掴んだまま振りむいた。
lines.english: —right. Remembering something, I turned with my hand still on the doorknob.

lines.japanese: 「ああ、あとアレ。てめ、この辺のことタカシに話すんじゃねえぞ」
lines.english: “Oh, and one more thing. Don't you tell Takashi about any of this.”

lines.japanese: いまだ突っ立って俯いていた男は、それを聞いて頭を下げたまま大きく首で頷いた。すだれみたいな鬱陶しい長髪が暑苦しく揺れた。
lines.english: Still standing there with his head bowed, the man gave a deep nod without looking up. His stifling curtain of long hair swayed.

lines.japanese: 「あと髪切れ髪」
lines.english: “And cut your damn hair.”

lines.japanese: そして俺はドアを開け、熱狂に溺れる真夜中のクラウドに呑みこまれていった。
lines.english: Then I opened the door and let the fevered midnight crowd swallow me.

lines.japanese: 縦に横に、アップにダウンに──
lines.english: Vertical and horizontal, up and down—

lines.japanese: ──まるで心臓の拍動をトレースしたような四つ打ちのリズムに身を委ね、百や二百の若いやつらが思うままに体を揺すぶっている。俺はそのうごめく壁を掻きわけて突きすすんだ。
lines.english: —a hundred, two hundred young bodies shook as they pleased, surrendering to a four-on-the-floor beat that traced the pulse of a heart. I forced my way through that writhing wall.

lines.japanese: 耳が痛い。目が痛い。肺が汚れる。早く夜空の下で深呼吸がしたかった。
lines.english: My ears hurt. My eyes hurt. My lungs grew filthy. I wanted to breathe deeply beneath the night sky.

lines.japanese: ぶつかった。よろめく。もはや誰に何が当たったのかも分からない混雑だ。体勢を立てなおす。黒いコート。覚えのある黒いコート。覚えのある浅黒い肌。
lines.english: I struck someone and staggered. The crush was too dense to tell who had hit what. I found my balance. A black coat. A black coat I knew. Dark skin I knew.

lines.japanese: 「カラス！」
lines.english: “Crow!”

lines.japanese: 踊りくるう人間たちの波に揉まれながら、いま俺は、あの輝ききれない明かりの下で別れたはずの男と息のかかる距離で対峙していた。
lines.english: Tossed in the waves of dancing bodies, I stood breath-close to the man I had thought I'd left beneath those lights that could never quite shine.

lines.japanese: 「ふン。なるほど、あいつか……たしかウチの三年だな」
lines.english: “Hmph. I see. Him... Third-year at our school, if memory serves.”

lines.japanese: 緑色にまたたくレーザー光線が、ハリューの冷たい三白眼を射していた。その眼が、俺のあとにしてきたガラスの王国を見据えてわずかに狭まった。
lines.english: Green laser light flickered across Haryu's cold eyes, the whites showing beneath the irises. They fixed on the glass kingdom I had left behind and narrowed slightly.

lines.japanese: 「てめぇ……尾けてきたのか」
lines.english: “You bastard... You followed me?”

lines.japanese: 「そりゃそうだろう。この程度の音、自主的に浴びに来る理由はないもんなァ」
lines.english: “Of course I did. I wouldn’t come here of my own free will for sound this lousy.”

lines.japanese: 「高音はよれる、中音は伸びない、低音は沈みすぎる。はン、俺がオーガナイザーだったら、たとえギャルサー相手のトラパライベントでもこんな糞箱は使わないだろうなァ」
lines.english: “The highs buckle, the mids won’t carry, and the lows sink too deep. Hmph. If I were running events, I wouldn’t book this dump even for a circle of flashy fashion girls dancing synchronized routines to trance.”

lines.japanese: 音楽グルメのうんざりした眼がＤＪブースの奥へ、それから全周囲に据えられた音響機器へと移ったが、最後には群衆の波を経由して森里のもとへ帰っていった。
lines.english: The jaded eyes of a musical gourmand moved to the back of the DJ booth, then over the sound system stationed around the room. At last they crossed the waves of the crowd and returned to Morisato.

lines.japanese: 「カラス。何しに来た」
lines.english: “Crow. What do you want?”

lines.japanese: 俺はやつの視界を塞ぐように体を寄せた。
lines.english: I moved closer to block his view.

lines.japanese: 「さあなァ、どうしてくれるか。ま、安心しろ、そう派手なことはしない──」
lines.english: “Who knows? What shall I do with him? Relax. I won't make too gaudy a spectacle—”

lines.japanese: 回遊魚のような留まらない瞳が、俺の頭から足元までをひと舐めしていった。
lines.english: His eyes swept me once from head to foot, never still, like a fish forever swimming.

lines.japanese: 「──保護観察中の身なんだ、俺もこれ以上は人間動物園で時間を浪費したくない」
lines.english: “—I'm on probation. I have no desire to waste any more time in the human zoo.”

lines.japanese: なだめすかすような穏やかな口調で、ハリューはそう言った。
lines.english: Haryu said it in a mild tone, as though soothing me.

lines.japanese: しかし、やつが森里和馬──自分を闇討ちした挙句、その罪を他人になすりつけた男──と友好的な挨拶を交わすために、わざわざ俺を尾行してきたはずはない。
lines.english: But he could hardly have followed me here to exchange friendly greetings with Kazuma Morisato—the man who had ambushed him, then planted the blame on someone else.

lines.japanese: 「どけ、ハヤブサ」
lines.english: “Move, Falcon.”

lines.japanese: 黒い腕がぬるりと俺の体に触れた。
lines.english: A black arm slid eel-like against my body.

lines.japanese: 「カラス」
lines.english: “Crow.”

lines.japanese: 俺はダンスフロアの床に脚を根ざして身を硬くした。ぬばたまの黒い視線が苛立ったように留まる。
lines.english: I rooted my feet in the dance floor and locked my body in place. His jet-black gaze stopped on me, irritated.

lines.japanese: 「なんだ」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 「あんさ。あいつ、受験あんだよ。もうチームもクビんなってるし、鳳ともすっぱり縁は切れてる」
lines.english: “Look. He's got entrance exams. He's already been kicked off the team, and he's cut ties with Otori completely.”

lines.japanese: 校舎から弾かれ、あるじに捨てられ、恋にも破れたあいつは、もう帰る場所がないと言った。だから、きっとこれから必死で新しい宿木を確保しようと足掻くだろう。
lines.english: Cast out of school, abandoned by his master, and defeated in love, he had said he had nowhere to go home to. Now he would struggle desperately to find a new perch.

lines.japanese: あいつは俺なんかと違ってものすごく器用に喋れるやつだから、大学でミーハーなサークルにでも入って大勢の仲間と上手く絡んで、すぐにまっとうな青春ってやつをやり直せるに違いない。
lines.english: Unlike me, he could talk with extraordinary skill. He would join some fashionable club at college, slip easily into a crowd of friends, and soon get a second chance at an ordinary young life.

lines.japanese: 「おまえからすりゃ虫のいい話かもしんねえけど、ここで問題起こしたらあいつ……なあ、分かんだろ」
lines.english: “Maybe that sounds awfully convenient from where you stand. But if you start trouble here, he'll... Come on. You understand.”

lines.japanese: 「あァ、分かったよ──」
lines.english: “Yes, I understand—”

lines.japanese: 動かない表情の中、静かな湖面のような瞳に一瞬ばかり容赦のない光が灯った。
lines.english: In his motionless face, his eyes, still as a lake, flashed mercilessly for an instant.

lines.japanese: 「──俺にはまったく関係ない話だってことがね」
lines.english: “—that none of this concerns me in the slightest.”

lines.japanese: 「カラス！」
lines.english: “Crow!”

lines.japanese: やつがゆらりと泳ぎだす。俺は必死で黒いコートの肩を掴んだ。触れた瞬間、ハリュー・クロードは凄まじい速度で体ごと振りかえった。
lines.english: He began to swim away. Desperate, I seized the shoulder of his black coat. The instant I touched him, Haryu Claude wheeled around with terrifying speed.

lines.japanese: 「干渉するなよ第三者。なあおい、俺はおまえとあいつの会談に口を挟まなかったぞ？　おまえも筋を通せよ、俺とやつの問題に口を挟むな」
lines.english: “Stay out of it, outsider. I didn’t butt into your talk with him, did I? Then play fair. Stay out of what’s between him and me.”

lines.japanese: そしてやつは両肩を回して俺の制止を振りほどき──泳ぎだす、波を抜ける、遠のいてゆく。
lines.english: He rolled both shoulders and shed my grip—then swam on, slipping through the waves, receding.

lines.japanese: 俺は──その背中を追えなかった。
lines.english: I—couldn't follow him.

lines.japanese: 「……クソが」
lines.english: “...Goddamn it.”

lines.japanese: 俺は後ろ頭をがしがし掻きながら、人ごみの中に悪態を吐きすてた。
lines.english: Raking the back of my head, I spat the curse into the crowd.

lines.japanese: 地上への出口を目指して突きすすみながら、昔じいさんに教わった言葉がふと甦った。
lines.english: As I forced my way toward the stairs to street level, words the old man had taught me long ago rose suddenly to mind.

lines.japanese: “自ら手を下さずとも、悪いやつにはおのずと天罰がくだる”
lines.english: ‘Even if you never raise a hand yourself, divine punishment will find the wicked on its own.’

lines.japanese: 違う。それはこういうことじゃなかったはずだ。この世には天使とか死神とか、そんなおめでたい連中はいないんだ。
lines.english: No. That wasn't what those words were supposed to mean. There were no angels or gods of death in this world—none of those convenient creatures.

lines.japanese: 押しつぶされそうな狭い階段をつたって夜空の下へ這いでると、冷たい冬の風が、翼のない汗ばんだ背中をべっとり撫でていった。
lines.english: I crawled up the crushingly narrow stairs and out beneath the night sky. Cold winter wind dragged a clammy hand across my sweating, wingless back.
